label: Audio Stream
description: Play a WAV audio file into a live Bus in real time: the file's 16-bit PCM is cut into short chunks and sent at the pace it would be spoken, so downstream realtime consumers (a live transcriber) see it exactly as a microphone would produce it. Drop a file, or wire an Audio value in.

inputs.name: audio
inputs.description: The WAV file to stream (16-bit PCM, mono).

outputs.name: stream
outputs.description: The live audio: a bytes Bus of raw 16-bit PCM frames ('audio' messages), its metadata declaring sample_rate and encoding; closed when the file ends.

outputs.name: done
outputs.description: True once the whole file has been streamed.
